title: InventoryRightclickBackspace
description: Makes it so u can use backspace as right click in inventory for people that dont want to set up keyboard place and want to rebind their rightclick to backspace and still use is as right click in minecraft.
body: I made this mod because i didn't want to set up keyboard place and still use the same thing almost , it makes it so u can use backspace in ur inventory like right click. Also because when u rebind ur right button to a random key u cant use it as right click , u cant split stacks , take stacks and all of that in ur inventory.
